audit.scope: Project-level license/NOTICE coverage for the pinned release CMake monolithic Dawn/Tint libraries and their reachable non-system third-party link/header/code-generation dependencies on Windows x86_64, Linux x86_64/aarch64 and macOS x86_64/arm64; plus the separately distributed Windows DXC compiler and substituted official DXIL validator. This inventory covers those components, not legal clearance of the whole application.
method: Read pinned top-level platform defaults, release cache overrides, bundling target graph, all 134 Dawn/Tint CMake build files and DEPS pins.
Followed all 81 tint_api transitive target dependencies conservatively across shipping backends; external edges resolve only src_utils (Dawn), Abseil and SPIR-V headers/tools.
Inspected native/common/system-utils/partition_alloc graph and imported Vulkan/EGL/RenderDoc/GL code-generation inputs; partition_alloc here is Dawn-authored shim, not external Chromium allocator.
Checked SPIR-V external dependency conditions and official DXC aggregate third-party notices.

Verified SHA256 of all five official Dawn platform archives against GitHub release digests and independently hashed their bundled library/runtime members; Linux/macOS static archive object inventories do not contain protobuf/glslang/re2/effcee/mimalloc/langsvr objects.
Original SDK DXIL provenance is superseded by a verified official release binary and its exact archive notices.

excluded_components.reason: Command/validator support is not reachable from tint_api; TINT_BUILD_CMD_TOOLS=OFF prevents adding glslang.
IR binary support OFF, tests/fuzzers/benchmarks OFF; neither is in the tint_api transitive closure.
Tests, executable tools and benchmarks are disabled; SPIRV_SKIP_TESTS and SPIRV_SKIP_EXECUTABLES forced ON.
Not in Dawn DEPS checkout; SPIRV-Tools requires MIMALLOC_DIR and static builds explicitly default OFF.
Not linked into shipped webgpu_dawn. Swiftshader OFF; Vulkan Loader only fuzz support; other fetched backend tooling/optional deps have no bundled target edges.
Language server and Mesa support OFF; no tint_api transitive target dependency.
Sample/window utility/test inputs disabled and not in shipped monolithic target.
Dawn CMake release uses platform SDK headers on Windows; external DirectX-Headers only used by non-Windows built-DXC, which release config does not enable.
DEPS entries support Chromium GN/toolchain; not linked by this release CMake bundled target. Platform C/C++ runtimes and OS frameworks are system imports, not copied from these deps.
Build-time generators only; not shipped runtime objects.
Ambiguous original SDK binary is deliberately replaced during package staging by the hash-pinned official DXC validator in windows_dxil.
